name: CLAIM_ICN_NBR
comment: Internal Control Number (ICN) is a 13-digit number that is assigned to each claim received by TennCare. ICN number is assigned by the insurance payer to every medical claim.

name: CLAIM_LINE_NBR
comment: The number that identifies a detail line of a Claim.

name: DE_LOAD_EVENT_ID
comment: Data Ecosystem Load Process Event Identifier for when the row was originally created.

name: DE_LOAD_TS
comment: Data Ecosystem Load Process Start Timestamp for when the Row was originally created.

name: DE_UPDT_EVENT_ID
comment: Data Ecosystem Load Process Timestamp for when the Row was updated.

name: DE_UPDT_TS
comment: Data Ecosystem Load Timestamp - identifies when this row was created within the Data Ecosystem

name: DE_ROW_HD
comment: Data Ecosystem Hash Difference Value: A hash of the columns within a row that can be compared to a version of the row to determine if the contents have changed.

name: DE_VERSION_HD
comment:
Data Ecosystem Version Hash Difference Value: A hash of the columns within a row that can be compared to the current instance of the row to determine if a new version of a dimension is warranted(Type 2).
When the Hash VERSION is different a new row is required(new VERSION) if only the Hash DIFF changes - than and Update (SCD type 1) is in order.

name: DE_CURRENT_ROW_IND
comment: Data Ecosystem Current Row Indicator indicates that the associated row is the only ‘current’ row for the given business key. There can be only one record with the "Y" (yes) value for the Current Record Indicator for a given business or natural key within the record.

name: DE_DELETE_IND
comment: Data Ecosystem Delete Indicator indicates if the row should be treated as a deleted row within Data Ecosystem.  Row is retained for audit purposes.

name: DE_ROW_BEGIN_DT
comment: Data Ecosystem Row Begin Timestamp indicates when the date and time a row became active within the Data Ecosystem.

name: DE_ROW_END_DT
comment: Data Ecosystem Row End Date indicates the date a row became inactive within the Data Ecosystem.

name: DE_SENSITIVE_DATA_IND
comment: Indicates the claim contains information related to Substance Use Disorder (SUD) diagnosis or treatment. This data is considered sensitive and is restricted from general access to only users authorized to view SUD data.

name: CLAIM_MCC_ICN_NBR
comment: Managed Care Organization Internal Control Number (MCC ICN) is a 13-digit number assigned by the MCO.

name: CLAIM_PAID_DT
comment: Date that financial completes the transaction.

name: CLAIM_CATEGORY_CD
comment:
The code that identifies the type of claim.  This is a derived data element meant to categorize the claim type at the highest level:
e.g.
PROF = Professional
DNTL = Dental
PHRM =  Pharmacy
INST = Institutional

name: CLAIM_CATEGORY_DESC
comment:
The text that describes a type or category of Claim.
e.g.
PROF = Professional
DNTL = Dental
PHRM =  Pharmacy
INST = Institutional

name: CLAIM_TYPE_CD
comment: The code that identifies the type of claim record. Physician claims are type M=medical or B=crossover Part B.

name: CLAIM_TYPE_DESC
comment: The text that describes a type of claim.

name: CLAIM_STATUS_CD
comment: The code that identifies the status of a Claim. e.g. "P" - paid, "D" - denied, "S" - Suspended, and "R" - Resubmitted.

name: CLAIM_STATUS_DESC
comment: The text that describes the status of a Claim.

name: BUDGET_YR
comment: The State fiscal year of the budget from which the funds were drawn.

name: BILL_MMIS_PROVLOC_DIM_SK
comment: System Generated Key to uniquely identify a row in the MMIS Provider Location Dimension to identify the MMIS Billing Provider Location.

name: BILL_MMIS_PROVIDER_ID
comment: The unique identifier for the MMIS Billing Provider. This the TennCare assigned Medicaid Id

name: BILL_MMIS_PROVLOC_ID
comment: An identifier for the Billing Provider Location.  This ID must be used in conjunction with the MMIS Billing Provider ID to be unique.

name: BILL_PROVIDER_DIM_SK
comment: System Generated Key to uniquely identify a row in the Provider Dimension table for the Billing Provider ID.

name: BILL_PROVIDER_ID
comment: The unique identifier for the Billing Provider. This could be Medicaid ID or NPI ID.

name: BILL_PROVIDER_ID_TYPE_CD
comment: Code that indicates the type of billing provider ID (i.e. Medicaid ID, NPI ID, DEA Number).

name: BILL_PROVIDER_TYPE_CD
comment: The code that identifies a type of Provider.

name: BILL_PROVIDER_TYPE_DESC
comment: The text that describes a type of Provider.

name: BILL_PROVIDER_SPECIALTY_CD
comment: This field contains the provider specialty which is the main focus of the providers practice. Each provider type must have a primary specialty and the primary specialty must be one of the providers existing specialties.

name: BILL_PROVIDER_SPECIALTY_DESC
comment: The text that describes a provider specialty code that was submitted on the claim.

name: MCO_DIM_SK
comment: System Generated Key to uniquely identify a row in the MCO Dimension table for the Managed Care Organization ID.

name: MCO_ID
comment: The unique Business identifier of the Managed Care Organization.

name: RENDER_MMIS_PROVLOC_DIM_SK
comment: System Generated Key to uniquely identify a row in the MMIS Provider Location Dimension to identify the MMIS Rendering Provider Location.

name: RENDER_MMIS_PROVIDER_ID
comment: The unique identifier for the MMIS Rendering Provider. This the TennCare assigned Medicaid Id

name: RENDER_MMIS_PROVLOC_ID
comment: An identifier for the Rendering Provider Location.  This ID must be used in conjunction with the MMIS Rendering Provider ID to be unique.

name: RENDER_PROVIDER_DIM_SK
comment: System Generated Key to uniquely identify a row in the Provider Dimension table for the Rendering Provider ID.

name: RENDER_PROVIDER_ID
comment: The unique BUSINESS identifier of the RENDERING Provider. This could be Medicaid ID or NPI ID.

name: RENDER_PROVIDER_ID_TYPE_CD
comment: Code that indicates the type of billing provider ID (i.e. Medicaid ID, NPI ID, DEA Number).

name: ATTEND_MMIS_PROVLOC_DIM_SK
comment: System Generated Key to uniquely identify a row in the MMIS Provider Location Dimension to identify the MMIS Attending Provider Location.

name: ATTEND_MMIS_PROVIDER_ID
comment: The unique identifier for the MMIS Attending Provider. This the TennCare assigned Medicaid Id

name: ATTEND_MMIS_PROVLOC_ID
comment: An identifier for the Attending Provider Location.  This ID must be used in conjunction with the MMIS Attending Provider ID to be unique.

name: ATTEND_PROVIDER_DIM_SK
comment: System Generated Key to uniquely identify a row in the Provider Dimension table for the Attending Provider ID.

name: ATTEND_PROVIDER_ID
comment: The unique  identifier of the Attending Provider. This could be Medicaid ID or NPI ID.

name: ATTEND_PROVIDER_ID_TYPE_CD
comment: Code that indicates the type of attending provider ID (i.e. Medicaid ID, NPI ID, DEA Number).

name: REFER_MMIS_PROVLOC_DIM_SK
comment: System Generated Key to uniquely identify a row in the MMIS Provider Location Dimension to identify the MMIS Referring Provider Location.

name: REFER_MMIS_PROVIDER_ID
comment: The unique identifier for the MMIS Referring Provider. This the TennCare assigned Medicaid Id

name: REFER_MMIS_PROVLOC_ID
comment: An identifier for the Rendering Provider Location.  This ID must be used in conjunction with the MMIS Rendering Provider ID to be unique.

name: REFER_PROVIDER_DIM_SK
comment: System Generated Key to uniquely identify a row in the Provider Dimension table for the first Referring Provider ID.

name: REFER_PROVIDER_ID
comment: The unique Business  identifier of the REFERRING Provider.

name: REFER_PROVIDER_ID_TYPE_CD
comment: Code that indicates the type of referring provider ID (i.e. Medicaid ID, NPI ID, DEA Number).

name: FACILITY_MMIS_PROVLOC_DIM_SK
comment: System Generated Key to uniquely identify a row in the MMIS Provider Location Dimension to identify the MMIS Facility Provider Location.

name: FACILITY_MMIS_PROVIDER_ID
comment: The unique identifier for the MMIS Facility Provider. This the TennCare assigned Medicaid Id

name: FACILITY_MMIS_PROVLOC_ID
comment: An identifier for the Facility Provider Location.  This ID must be used in conjunction with the MMIS Facility Provider ID to be unique.

name: FACILITY_PROVIDER_DIM_SK
comment: System Generated Key to uniquely identify a row in the  in MMIS_PROVLOC_DIM table for the Facility Provider ID.

name: FACILITY_PROVIDER_ID
comment: The unique identifier of the Facility.

name: FACILITY_PROVIDER_ID_TYPE_CD
comment: Code that indicates the type of provider ID for the facility (i.e. Medicaid ID, NPI ID, DEA Number).

name: PRESCRIBE_MMIS_PROVLOC_DIM_SK
comment: System Generated Key to uniquely identify a row in the MMIS Provider Location Dimension to identify the MMIS Prescribing Provider Location.

name: PRESCRIBE_MMIS_PROVIDER_ID
comment: The unique identifier for the MMIS Prescribing Provider. This the TennCare assigned Medicaid Id

name: PRESCRIBE_MMIS_PROVLOC_ID
comment: An identifier for the Prescribing Provider Location.  This ID must be used in conjunction with the MMIS Prescribing Provider ID to be unique.

name: PRESCRIBE_PROVIDER_DIM_SK
comment: System Generated Key to uniquely identify a row in MMIS_PROVLOC_DIM

name: PRESCRIBE_PROVIDER_ID
comment: The unique identifier for the Prescribing Provider.

name: PRESCRIBE_PROVIDER_ID_TYPE_CD
comment: Code that indicates the type of Provider ID (i.e. Medicaid ID, NPI ID, DEA Number).

name: SUBMIT_PRESCRIBE_PROVIDER_ID
comment: The unique identifier for the Submitting Prescribing Provider.

name: BENEFICIARY_DIM_SK
comment: System Generated Key to uniquely identify a row in the Beneficiary Dimension table.

name: BENEFICIARY_ID_TYPE_CD
comment: Code that indicates the type of Beneficiary ID (i.e. MEDICAID).

name: BENEFICIARY_ID
comment: The Medicaid ID of the Client.

name: BENEFICIARY_BIRTH_DT
comment: The birth date of the Client - as reflected in the client dimension as claim is loaded

name: BENEFICIARY_AGE_YRS
comment: The members age is  base on the date of birth sourced from BENEFICIARY_DIM. Years are calculated using the claim line first date of service. Fractions of a year are rounded down.

name: BENEFICIARY_AGE_MTHS
comment: The members age in months is  base on the date of birth sourced from BENEFICIARY_DIM. Months are calculated using the claim line first date of service. Fractions of a month are rounded down.

name: PAYMENT_LEVEL_CD
comment: Code representing the level of the associated payment (CLM vs LINE)

name: PAYMENT_LEVEL_DESC
comment: Description of the code representing the payment Level (Claim Level vs Claim Line Level)

name: REGION_CD
comment: This is the MMIS system region code the claim processed under. The field id derived from the first 2 characters of the CLAIM_ICN_NBR.

name: REGION_DESC
comment: The text that describes the region code of the claim.

name: CLAIM_VOID_IND
comment: Indicates if this claim adjustment is a void of the previously paid claim.

name: CLAIM_DSNP_IND
comment:
Indicates that the claim is related to a Dual Special Needs(D-SNP) plan.

D-SNP is a type of health insurance plan. It for people who have both Medicare and Medicaid, or dual-eligible.

Dual Special Needs plans are for people who could use more help. That may be because of income, disabilities, age and/or health conditions. Dual Special Needs plans are a type of Medicare Advantage plan.

TennCare identifies DSNP  claims based on the Submitter.  If the last 3 digits of a Submitter is in the list below - claim is tagged as DSNP.
(AGC, CHI, HEA, UHC, VSH, WHP)

name: ENCOUNTER_IND
comment: This field indicates if the claim is an encounter. Valid values Y or N.

name: LAST_CLAIM_IND
comment: Used to signify that the associated claim is the most recent for this specific service/claim.  If a claim is adjusted this will be set to N (No).  A new claim or a new adjustment to a claim will be added to table with this flag set to Y.

name: CLAIM_ADJUSTED_DT
comment: When a claim is adjusted, the paid date of the Adjusting claim will be placed on the claim being Adjusted  This will signify when the claim was no longer the most recent claim.

name: ADJUSTMENT_ICN_NBR
comment: The ICN Number of the Adjustment Claim that is replacing this claim.

name: ADJUSTMENT_REASON_CD
comment: The code that identifies the reason that a claim was adjusted.

name: ADJUSTMENT_REASON_DESC
comment: The text that describes the reason that a claim was adjusted.

name: CLAIM_BILL_AMT
comment: Amount requested by provider for services rendered.

name: CLAIM_NET_BILL_AMT
comment: Amount remaining on a claim after payment has been made by all other sources (TPL).

name: CLAIM_TPL_SUBMIT_AMT
comment: The amount of TPL entered on the claim.

name: CLAIM_TPL_APPLIED_AMT
comment: The amount of TPL applied to the claim during claims adjudication.

name: CLAIM_ALLOW_AMT
comment: Amount reimbursed to provider.

name: CLAIM_PAID_AMT
comment: Amount sent to a provider for payment for services rendered to a Client.

name: CLAIM_COPAY_AMT
comment: Amount paid by Client for services rendered.

name: CLAIM_REIMBURSE_AMT
comment: Amount reimbursed to provider.

name: CLAIM_COINS_AMT
comment: Amount to be collected from the patient that is included in  Patient Pay Amount  that is due to a per prescription coinsurance.

name: CLAIM_DEDUCT_AMT
comment: Amount to be collected from a patient that is included in  Patient Pay Amount  that is applied to a periodic deductible.

name: CLAIM_PATIENT_LIABILITY_AMT
comment: Amount recipient is responsible to pay for services rendered.

name: ENCOUNTER_PAID_AMT
comment: The calculated amount paid for the encounter using encounter amount allowed minus patient resources such as deductions and TPL payments using the State service line reduction methodology.

name: MEDICARE_PAID_DT
comment: The date when Medicare made payment for a claim.

name: MEDICARE_ALLOW_AMT
comment: The amount allowed by Medicare for a given service.

name: MEDICARE_PAID_AMT
comment: The amount Medicare paid for the service.

name: MEDICARE_DEDUCT_AMT
comment: The amount patient pay for covered health care services before Medicare starts to pay.

name: MEDICARE_COINS_AMT
comment: The coinsurance amount based on Medicare policy

name: MEDICARE_BLOOD_DEDUCT_AMT
comment: The amount the patient must pay for blood purchased before Medicare starts to pay.

name: MEDICARE_COINS_DAYS_CNT
comment: The number of coinsurance days based on Medicare policy

name: MEDICARE_LTR_DAYS_CNT
comment: The life time reserved days count based on Medicare policy.

name: PROVIDER_SERVICE_COUNTY_DIM_SK
comment: Dimension Surrogate Key/System Generated Key that identifies a specific row in the County_Dim table and identifies the Providers Service County.

name: PROVIDER_SERVICE_COUNTY_CD
comment: The code that identifies a COUNTY.

name: PROVIDER_SERVICE_COUNTY_NM
comment: The text that describes or names a COUNTY.

name: CLAIM_BILL_DT
comment: Date on which the provider or billing service prepared the claim form to be submitted.

name: CLAIM_ADJUDIC_DT
comment: Date the claim or adjustment is processed.

name: CLAIM_LINE_CNT
comment: Total number of details associated with the claim header.

name: CLAIM_FIRST_SERVICE_DT
comment: Date on a claim representing the first date a service was rendered for a beneficiary.

name: CLAIM_LAST_SERVICE_DT
comment: Date on a claim representing the last date a service was rendered for a patient.

name: RECEIPT_DT
comment: Date the claim was received.

name: REL_CAUSE_CD
comment:
Signifies if there is a related cause such as an accident.

From 837 - valid values include
AA=Auto Accident
EM=Employment
OA=Other Accident

name: REL_CAUSE_DESC
comment: The text description of the related cause code.

name: ELECTRONIC_CLAIM_IND
comment: This field is keyed to indicate if the provider is a possible electronic biller.

name: PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR
comment: Identification for a Client assigned by a provider and used in their system. This number is not required for processing (information only).

name: MEDICAL_RECORD_NBR
comment: Medical Record Number.

name: ADMIT_SOURCE_CD
comment: The source of admission code that is found in block 20 of the UB92 claim form for inpatient and LTC claims.

name: ADMIT_SOURCE_DESC
comment: A description of the source of admission code that is found in block 20 of the UB92 claim form for inpatient and LTC claims.

name: ADMIT_TYPE_CD
comment: Code which indicates the priority of the admission for inpatient or outpatient care.

name: ADMIT_TYPE_DESC
comment: A description of the code which indicates the priority of the admission for inpatient or outpatient care.

name: ADMISSION_DT
comment: The date on which the Beneficiary was admitted.

name: ADMISSION_TIME
comment: ADMIT TIME - is the hour and minute during which the patient was admitted for inpatient or outpatient care.

name: DISCHARGE_DT
comment: The Date a patient was discharged from a facility. This is derived from Last service date and Patient Disposition.

name: DISCHARGE_TIME
comment: This is the Discharge Hour in format HHMM.

name: TYPE_OF_BILL_CD
comment: Contains the type of bill field from the UB-92 field comprised of type of facility, class, and frequency

name: TYPE_OF_BILL_DESC
comment: Describes the type of bill field from the UB-92 field comprised of type of facility, class, and frequency

name: CLAIM_FREQUENCY_CD
comment:
Claims Frequency Code.  Code specifying the reason for claim submission.

Code specifying the frequency of the claim; this is the third position of
the Uniform Billing Claim Form Bill Type.

name: CLAIM_FREQUENCY_DESC
comment: The text that describes the claim frequency.

name: PATIENT_STATUS_CD
comment: Code which indicates the status of the Client as of the ending service date of the period covered on a UB92 claim.

name: PATIENT_STATUS_DESC
comment: The text that describes the patient status of the Client.

name: CLAIM_DAYS_COVER_CNT
comment: Indicates the number of covered days for the statement period of the claim.

name: CLAIM_DAYS_NON_COVER_CNT
comment: Indicates the number of days not covered for the statement period of the claim.

name: ED_VISIT_IND
comment: Indicates whether the claim is related to an Emergency Department Visit.

name: CLAIM_DIAGNOSIS_1_CD
comment: The first diagnosis code submitted on the claim (sequence number = 01).

name: CLAIM_DIAGNOSIS_1_DIM_SK
comment: Unique identifier for the Diagnosis Dimension table. This identifies a unique record on the table.

name: CLAIM_DIAGNOSIS_2_CD
comment: The second diagnosis code submitted on the claim (sequence number = 02).

name: CLAIM_DIAGNOSIS_2_DIM_SK
comment: Unique identifier for the Diagnosis Dimension table. This identifies a unique record on the table.

name: CLAIM_DIAGNOSIS_3_CD
comment: The third diagnosis code submitted on the claim (sequence number = 03).

name: CLAIM_DIAGNOSIS_3_DIM_SK
comment: Unique identifier for the Diagnosis Dimension table. This identifies a unique record on the table.

name: CLAIM_DIAGNOSIS_4_CD
comment: The fourth diagnosis code submitted on the claim (sequence number = 04).

name: CLAIM_DIAGNOSIS_4_DIM_SK
comment: Unique identifier for the Diagnosis Dimension table. This identifies a unique record on the table.

name: PRESCRIPTION_NBR
comment: Number assigned by a pharmacy to identify the drug dispensed to a Client.

name: PRESCRIBE_DT
comment: Date physician prescribed drug for a Client.

name: PRESCRIBE_QTY
comment: The prescribed quantity expressed in metric decimal units.

name: DRUG_DAYS_SUPPLY_QTY
comment: Number of days a prescribed drug should last a Client.

name: DISPENSE_FEE_AMT
comment: This is the amount that the provider receives for dispensing a prescription drug.

name: USUAL_AND_CUSTOMARY_CHARGE_AMT
comment: Usual and customary charge submitted by the provider.

name: DUR_INTERVENE_CD
comment: Record of whether a drug utilization and review intervention code was given in response to a ProDUR alert. The intervention code indicates whom the pharmacist consulted with (nobody, physician, Client) to decide whether to fill the prescription.

name: DUR_INTERVENE_DESC
comment: The text that describes the Drug Utilization Review (DUR) Intervention Code.

name: DUR_OUTCOME_CD
comment: The outcome code returned from the provider in response to a Prospective Drug Utilization Review alert. This code indicates whether the prescription was filled as is, changed, or not filled.

name: DUR_OUTCOME_DESC
comment: The text that describes the  Drug Utilization Review (DUR) I Outcome code.

name: REFILL_SEQUENCE_NBR
comment: This is the refill number for the prescribed drug.  The first time the prescription is filled, this attribute will be 0. For each subsequent refill this attribute will be incremented by 1.

name: AUTH_REFILL_CNT
comment: Number of refills authorized by the prescriber.

name: BRAND_MEDICAL_NECESSITY_CD
comment: This field indicates the reason, if any, that a brand name drug was dispensed.  (Note 10 codes used, no lookup)

name: BRAND_MEDICAL_NECESSITY_DESC
comment: The text that describes the Brand Medical Necessity code for this claim.

name: SPECIAL_PACK_CD
comment: Code indicating the type of dispensing dose.  (Note: 10 codes, no lookup!)

name: SPECIAL_PACK_DESC
comment: The text that describes the special pack code.

name: PRIOR_AUTH_NBR
comment: Unique identifier submitted by the provider to identify a prior authorization.

name: CLAIM_AWP_UNIT_AMT
comment: Average Wholesale Price per unit for the drug as defined by processor.

name: CLAIM_BRAND_SELECT_AMT
comment: Amount to be collected from the patient that is included in  Patient Pay Amount  that is due to the patient s selection of a Brand product.

name: COVERAGE_GAP_AMT
comment: Amount to be collected from the patient that is included in  Patient Pay Amount  that is due to the patient being in the coverage gap (for example Medicare Part D Coverage Gap (donut hole)).

name: FEDERAL_UPPER_LIMIT_UNIT_AMT
comment: Federal Upper Limit Unit Price as defined by processor.

name: MAC_AMT
comment: Indicates the unit maximum allowable cost price for the product/service as defined by the processor.

name: FLAT_TAX_AMT
comment: Flat sales tax paid which is included in the  Total Amount Paid

name: INCENTIVE_AMT
comment: Amount represents the contractually agreed upon incentive fee paid for specific services rendered. Amount is included in the  Total Amount Paid

name: NETWORK_SELECT_AMT
comment: Amount to be collected from the patient that is included in  Patient Pay Amount  that is due to the patient s provider network selection.

name: NON_PREFER_BRAND_SELECT_AMT
comment: Amount to be collected from the patient that is included in  Patient Pay Amount  that is due to the patient s selection of a non preferred brand product.

name: NON_PREFER_PRODUCT_SELECT_AMT
comment: Amount to be collected from the patient that is included in  Patient Pay Amount  that is due to the patient s selection of a non-preferred product.

name: PRODUCT_SELECT_AMT
comment: Amount to be collected from the patient that is included in  Patient Pay Amount  that is due to the patient s selection of drug product.

name: SALE_TAX_AMT
comment: Amount to be collected from the patient that is included in  Patient Pay Amount  that is due to sales tax paid.

name: ALL_SOURCE_PAID_AMT
comment: The dollars amount paid from all payer(s).

name: NURSE_HOME_IND
comment: Indicates whether the drug was dispensed for a Client who resides in a nursing home facility.

name: PREGNANCY_IND
comment: Indicates whether service is related to condition of being pregnant.

name: PAYMENT_ID
comment: Unique identifier assigned by the sender to reference individual pharmacy and member reimbursement (e.g., check or EFT trace number).

name: MAC_REDUCE_IND
comment: Indicates if a claim payment was reduced due to a MAC (Maximum Allowable Cost) program.

name: SERVICE_LEVEL_CD
comment: Code to identify the type of service the provider rendered.

name: SERVICE_LEVEL_DESC
comment: The text that describes the Service Level Code applied to this claim.

name: PARTIAL_REFILL_CD
comment: Code to identify the quantity dispensed is a partial fill or the completion of a partial fill. Used only in situations where inventory shortages do not allow the full quantity to be dispensed.

name: PARTIAL_REFILL_DESC
comment: The text that describes the partial refill code.

name: LINE_FIRST_SERVICE_DT
comment: The first date on which services are rendered for a Client.

name: LINE_LAST_SERVICE_DT
comment: Date on which services were last performed for a Client.

name: LINE_STATUS_CD
comment: The code that identifies the status of Line Item. e.g. "P" - paid, "D" - denied, "S" - Suspended, and "R" - Resubmitted.

name: LINE_STATUS_DESC
comment: The text that describes the status of the Line Item.

name: LINE_BILL_AMT
comment: Amount of money requested for payment by a provider for services rendered to a recipient.

name: LINE_ALLOW_AMT
comment: Amount approved to pay for services provided to a recipient.

name: LINE_ENCOUNTER_ALLOW_AMT
comment: The calculated allowed amount for an encounter service using the States medical and payment policy.

name: LINE_PAID_AMT
comment: The amount of money paid for the service line of the encounter/claim.  This is reduced by patient resources such as deductions and TPL payments using the Payer reduction methodology.

name: LINE_ENCOUNTER_PAID_AMT
comment: The calculated amount paid for the encounter using encounter amount allowed minus patient resources such as deductions and TPL payments using the State service line reduction methodology.

name: LINE_CO_PAY_AMT
comment: Co-pay amount for a service line.

name: LINE_TPL_SUBMIT_AMT
comment: This is the total amount paid by this payer for this detail. This is a derived field computed from the CAS segments on the 837 as follows. The total Provider Adjustment Amt (DA3-25.0) for a detail equals the sum of all the adjustment amounts inCAS03, 06, 09, 12, 15, and 18. Subtracting this amount form detail billed amounts yields the detail TPL amount.

name: LINE_TPL_APPLIED_AMT
comment: The amount of TPL applied to the claim line during claims adjudication.

name: LINE_NON_COVER_AMT
comment: NON COVERED AMOUNT - is Service Line Non-Covered Charge Amount, Line Item Denied Charge or Non-Covered Charge Amount.

name: BILL_QTY
comment: Number of units of service that were provided.

name: ALLOW_QTY
comment: Number of units of service that will be paid for.

name: LINE_MEDICARE_PAID_DT
comment: The date when Medicare made payment for a claim.

name: LINE_MEDICARE_ALLOW_AMT
comment: The amount allowed by Medicare for a given service.

name: LINE_MEDICARE_PAID_AMT
comment: The amount Medicare paid for the service.

name: LINE_MEDICARE_COINS_AMT
comment: The coinsurance amount based on Medicare policy

name: LINE_MEDICARE_DEDUCT_AMT
comment: The amount patient pay for covered health care services before Medicare starts to pay.

name: LINE_MEDICARE_PSYCHIATRIC_AMT
comment: Amount Medicare has determined the recipient must pay for psychiatric services received.

name: POS_CD
comment: Location where service was rendered.

name: POS_DESC
comment: The text that describes the type of location where service was rendered.

name: CONTRACT_TYPE_CD
comment:
Code to identify the type of contract under which a claim is tied to.

 F  - Fee for service encounter
 C  - Capitated payment encounter

name: CONTRACT_TYPE_DESC
comment: The text that describes the type of contract under which a claim is tied to.

name: EMERGENCY_CD
comment: Indicates whether the service was provided as result of emergency situation.

name: EMERGENCY_DESC
comment: The text that describes the type of emergency under which a claim is tied to.

name: EPSDT_FP_CD
comment: Code to identify Child Health Check Up (CHCUP - formerly EPSDT) or Family planning information.  E=patient referred as part of CHCUP screening, V=patient refused referral/available not used, U=patient not referred/not used, 2=under treatment, T=new services requested, F=services related to pregnancy or family planning

name: EPSDT_FP_DESC
comment: The text that describes the EPSDT/ Family Planning code.

name: LINE_PRICE_CD
comment: Indicates which pricing methodology was applied to the procedure provided.

name: LINE_PRICE_DESC
comment: The text that describes the type of pricing applied to the claim line.

name: LINE_DIAGNOSIS_1_DIM_SK
comment: Unique identifier for the Diagnosis Dimension table. This identifies a unique record on the table.

name: LINE_DIAGNOSIS_1_CD
comment: The code that identifies the first medical condition or diagnosis related to the claim line for professional claims.

name: LINE_DIAGNOSIS_1_SEQUENCE_CD
